shell.title: Instance administration
shell.description: Cross-instance operational diagnostics. Tenant data is represented by identifiers only.

shellHealth.label: Operations health
shellHealth.workerUnknownHint: The app is running, but the separate worker has not published a fresh heartbeat. The web process does not start the worker.

rankChecks.title: Rank checks
rankChecks.description: Execution totals and schedule-to-start lag. Deferred rows never count as successes.
rankChecks.failureDescription: Checks that failed after exhausting all providers. Grouped by provider and summarized reason.
rankChecks.fallbackDescription: Checks that completed only after a primary provider failed. Grouped by the provider that failed and the summarized reason.
rankChecks.fallbackEmpty: No fallback rank checks in the last 24 hours.

dataSources.title: Data sources
dataSources.description: Per-provider sync health across all connections. Per-connection detail is available only through Account lookup.

presence.title: URL presence
presence.description: Latest property-budget deferral from the daily URL-presence workflow. The budget resets automatically.

temporal.title: Temporal
temporal.description: Scheduled background tasks, recorded counters and startup diagnostics.
temporal.snapshotUnavailable: Snapshot unavailable - worker has not published Temporal data. Values above are unknown, not zero.
temporal.disabled: Temporal scheduling is disabled for this topology.
temporal.counterNote: Totals recorded over each schedule’s lifetime, not a current backlog. A skipped start means the previous run was still active.
temporal.noCounters: No missed or overlapping starts recorded.
temporal.inspectionPartial: {count, plural, one {# schedule could not be inspected.} other {# schedules could not be inspected.}} These totals may be incomplete.

ops.title: Ops events
ops.description: Recent operator events show delivery metadata only; free-form payload fields are never exposed here.
ops.slackMissing: Slack is not configured. Set OPS_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL to deliver operator events.

stats.title: Instance stats
stats.description: Instance counts and completed SERP usage for the current UTC month.

emailAllowance.title: Email sending today
emailAllowance.description: Daily safety limits for this installation.
emailAllowance.help: Each reserved recipient send counts toward this limit, including attempts that later fail. These are local application limits, not delivered-message totals or a provider account quota.
emailAllowance.notConfigured: Email sending is not configured for this installation.
emailAllowance.configurationUnavailable: Email settings could not be read.

worker.title: Worker
worker.description: Worker heartbeat, deployment identity, database schema agreement, and Slack delivery configuration.
worker.disabled: Scheduled worker is disabled for this topology.

failureBreakdown.empty: No failed rank checks in the last 24 hours.
failureBreakdown.acrossProjects: across {count, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}}

providerUsage.empty: No completed SERP checks this month.
providerUsage.tableLabel: SERP usage this month by provider
providerUsage.note: Reference estimates use maintained provider rates and recorded request units. User-entered costs are ignored; provider invoices remain authoritative.

growth.title: Growth
growth.description: 30-day UTC aggregates. No behavioral analytics or tenant content.
growth.delta: {direction, select, positive {+{value, number, ::.0}% vs prior 30 days} negative {-{value, number, ::.0}% vs prior 30 days} other {0.0% vs prior 30 days}}
growth.activeAccountsDescription: Distinct accounts with session activity in the last 7 days.

consumption.title: Top consumption
consumption.description: Top 10 project/provider rows by reference cost this month. User-entered rates are ignored.
consumption.empty: No completed SERP checks recorded this month.
consumption.note: Reference costs use maintained provider rates and recorded request units. Provider invoices remain authoritative.
consumption.tableLabel: Top project and provider consumption this month

mailer.title: Email provider not configured
mailer.description: Email sign-in is unavailable because this instance cannot send sign-in codes. Set {provider} and its required credentials to restore email delivery.
mailer.descriptionLocked: Two-factor authentication is required to save or change mail settings. Settings already saved keep sending if it is turned off. Environment variables still override saved settings.
mailer.descriptionReady: Email sign-in is unavailable until a provider is saved below. Environment variables still override saved settings.
mailer.locked: The mail form appears after you turn on two-factor authentication.

form.title: Outbound mail
form.description: Saved settings are used only when the matching environment variables are empty. Environment variables win when both are set.
form.envOverride: Environment variables are set, so they override these saved settings.
form.sesKeysHint: Optional. Leave both empty to use the server's default credential chain.
form.cleared: Saved mail settings cleared. Environment variables apply.
form.invalid: Check the form and try again.
form.stepUpFailed: That authenticator code was not accepted.
form.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
form.validationSender: Enter a sender as Name '<'address@example.com'>' or a plain address.
form.validationSesPair: Enter both the access key ID and the secret access key, or leave both empty.

account.title: Account lookup
account.description: Exact-match lookup returning account metadata only - never tenant content.
account.validationIdentifier: Enter an exact email or user ID.
account.auditNotice: Lookups are recorded in the admin audit log.

lookup.invalidIdentifier: Enter an exact email or user ID.
lookup.rateLimited: Too many account lookups. Try again shortly.

actions.deactivated: Account deactivated. Sessions and personal access tokens were revoked; scheduled checks pause on reconciliation.
actions.reactivated: Account reactivated. Scheduled checks will reconverge on reconciliation.
actions.rateLimited: This account action was rate limited. Try again shortly.
actions.limitsCompleted: Rate limits reset; monthly spend is a rolling window and cannot be reset
actions.limitsFailed: Rate limits could not be reset.

opsActions.notConfigured: Slack operator notifications are not configured.
opsActions.rateLimited: This admin action was rate limited. Try again shortly.
opsActions.sweepCompleted: Outbox sweep completed: {delivered, number} of {attempted, number} delivered.
opsActions.failed: The operator action could not be completed.

audit.title: Admin activity
audit.description: instance_admin.* entries. Visible to instance admins only; admins are not anonymous to each other.
audit.empty: No instance-admin audit entries match this filter.

metering.title: Metering
metering.heading: Metering
metering.description: Recorded usage, current budgets and unresolved operations.
metering.unavailableNote: Metering data is unavailable. Amounts and counts are unknown.
metering.truncated: Showing a bounded selection. Filter by project to narrow the results.
metering.budgetNote: Budgets show the current cycle, independently of the selected usage month.

announcements.heading: User announcements
announcements.description: Prepare several messages and choose which ones appear above workspace pages. New messages are saved with visibility off.
announcements.refreshHelp: Users see changes after refreshing the page. All enabled messages are shown.
announcements.title: Title
announcements.linkHelp: Use an HTTP(S) address or an app path starting with /. Leave the URL empty for a message without a link.
announcements.deleteDescription: Delete “{title}”? If it is enabled, it will disappear when users refresh the page.
announcements.validationText: Enter a title (1–120 characters) and a message (1–2,000 characters).
announcements.validationLink: Enter a valid HTTP(S) URL or app path, and link text up to 80 characters.

errors.forbidden: Only an instance administrator can manage announcements.
errors.not_found: This announcement no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.conflict: Another administrator changed this announcement. Refresh the page before saving again.
errors.unavailable: The announcement could not be saved. Try again.

recovery.heading: Task recovery
recovery.description: Check what was sent, what finished, and what remains unconfirmed.
recovery.newAttemptNote: If there is no retained result and no positive proof that sending never began, ask a project member with spending authority to create a new run through the normal preview and budget checks. This may cost extra. The original charge still requires separate reconciliation.
recovery.triageNote: Follow-up status, assignment and waiting do not settle costs or lift spending restrictions. A changed case or expired waiting period reopens the case.
recovery.noSpend: Proof reconciliation and result restoration make no provider requests and create no additional paid attempts. Restoring a result does not settle an unknown charge.
recovery.recheckNote: Each case and administrator permission will be checked again by the worker. Changed cases are skipped.
recovery.batchLimit: Up to {count, number} cases per command
recovery.safetyNote: A missing confirmation does not mean the request was never sent. Only positive evidence can prove acceptance or a safe no-send state. Historical accounting uncertainty is shown separately from unfinished work.
recovery.outcomes: Recovered: {recovered, number}. Original runs queued: {queued, number}. Unchanged: {unchanged, number}. Failed: {failed, number}. Changed or skipped: {skipped, number}.
recovery.unavailable: Recovery cases are temporarily unavailable. Refresh to try again.

blocked.proof_missing: No sufficient retained provider proof. Keep the cost unknown and obtain native evidence.
blocked.wallet_coordination_required: No verified original platform proof is available for coordinated settlement.
blocked.authorization_required: A new paid attempt needs project spending authority and normal admission.
blocked.project_unavailable: The original project or work is no longer available.
blocked.result_context_changed: The retained result cannot be restored to the current task context.

errors.forbidden: Administrator access is no longer available.
errors.rate_limited: Too many actions. Try again shortly.
errors.unavailable: Recovery is temporarily unavailable. Refresh the command status before retrying.
errors.case_changed: This case changed or is no longer eligible. Refresh and review it again.
errors.invalid: Select a reason and a future waiting period.

recovery.originalRunSpend: Resume {count, number} original, unstarted runs under the owner’s retained authorization. Normal provider admission may send paid requests and use the existing run budget. No new run or duplicate paid attempt is created.
recovery.approvedExposure: Approved maximum: {cents} USD cents, {targets, number} targets, {attempts, number} attempt per target.
recovery.pageGrouping: Grouping applies to this page. Filters and next page cover the full backlog.
recovery.blockedScopes: Spending blocked by uncertainty: {projects, number} projects, {connections, number} connections.
recovery.projectBlocked: Project spending is blocked by unresolved accounting.
recovery.connectionBlocked: Connection spending is blocked by unresolved accounting.
recovery.lastResultActivityAt: Result recovery worker last made progress
recovery.noSpendShort: Recovery checks existing evidence before taking action.
